title: Bahria College DHA Phase 2 Campus, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Bahria College DHA Phase 2 Campus, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: Sabir SRE, Defence Housing Authority, Karachi. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Karachi as the city.
